query:
INSERT INTO message_draft_link_preview (
                    chat_id, url, card, image, fetched_at
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT(chat_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    url = excluded.url,
                    card = excluded.card,
                    image = excluded.image,
                    fetched_at = excluded.fetched_at
